title: Sahaay AI Phase 21: End-to-End System Evaluation & Readiness Audit Report
overall_conclusion: Sahaay AI demonstrates complete, robust software engineering correctness and strict cross-component contract integrity across all Phases 12 through 20. However, operational deployment and live emergency dispatch remain firmly BLOCKED due to: (1) statutory restrictions under the Disaster Management Act (2005), (2) the absence of localized rain gauges in the GHMC core corridor, (3) the absence of an authorized operational forecast provider, (4) unmonitored road status and missing routable network topologies, and (5) vision model source-confounding requiring local field evaluation before any predictive claims can be made.

scenario_a_missing_evidence.description: Missing telemetry, road reports, and network data preserve missingness without false safety

scenario_b_severe_forecast_no_ground.description: Forward-looking advisory concern without declaring active corridor inundation or road closure

scenario_c_static_vulnerability_dry.description: High static susceptibility in dry weather remains CLEAR; does not trigger closure

scenario_d_verified_impassable_propagati.description: Authorized responder verification excludes road from routing and triggers P1 emergency review

scenario_e_conflicting_or_stale_reports.description: Conflicting or expired community reports enter DEGRADED mode and do not assume safety

scenario_f_ambiguous_vision_result.description: Vision prediction in [0.35, 0.65] band abstains and does not promote to flood evidence

scenario_g_emergency_review_lifecycle.description: Urgent incidents require authorized human review; unauthorized users rejected; audit hash generated

scenario_h_operational_action_boundaries.description: System cannot trigger physical dispatch, external emergency contact, or road barricading

scenario_i_routing_without_road_graph.description: Zero routable edges on disk results in INSUFFICIENT_DATA without fabricated path or travel time

scenario_j_forecast_source_unavailable.description: No authorized operational forecast feed configured; offline testing passes while live feed blocked

1_software_engineering_and_contracts.definition: Codebase schemas, type annotations, runtime validators, immutability contracts, and audit hashes are completely implemented and verified offline.
1_software_engineering_and_contracts.evidence: 430 passed unit/integration tests across Phases 12-21; 0 lint or contract regressions.

2_cross_component_integration.definition: Integration boundaries between contracts, telemetry, vision, reports, road status, flood risk, forecast risk, routing, and emergency mode pass all deterministic scenarios without contradictory states.
2_cross_component_integration.evidence: 11/11 end-to-end integration tests pass in tests/test_phase21_end_to_end.py covering Scenarios A-J.

3_vision_data_and_model_validity.definition: Laboratory prototypes trained on web data (ImageNet/ADE20k) cannot be deployed in Hyderabad without local annotated data and sealed field evaluation.
3_vision_data_and_model_validity.evidence: Phase 14 NO-GO gate confirmed; zero independent local ground truth evaluation sets; abstention band [0.35, 0.65] strictly active.

4_observed_rainfall_data_readiness.definition: Adequate spatial and temporal density of hyper-local rain gauges within the urban road corridor.
4_observed_rainfall_data_readiness.evidence: 0 operating rain gauges in GHMC core corridor; nearest IMD stations (Begumpet/Shamshabad) are 35-50km regional catchments.

5_forecast_source_readiness.definition: Authorized, authenticated operational API feeds for numerical weather prediction (NWP) precipitation grids.
5_forecast_source_readiness.evidence: 0 operational forecast providers configured; external live feeds disabled by safety protocol.

6_road_network_and_current_condition.definition: Topological routable vector graph of Hyderabad with live telemetry sensors on road corridors.
6_road_network_and_current_condition.evidence: 0 routable network edges stored on disk; zero live road waterlogging sensors deployed; routing gracefully returns INSUFFICIENT_DATA.

7_emergency_review_and_authorization.definition: Statutory delegation under the Disaster Management Act (2005) and certified 24/7 human dispatcher desk.
7_emergency_review_and_authorization.evidence: Autonomous dispatch legally prohibited without magistrate order; GHMC DRF and Traffic Police bilateral MoUs pending execution; human desk unstaffed.

8_operational_deployment_readiness.definition: Overall readiness for public deployment or autonomous municipal dispatch in Hyderabad.
8_operational_deployment_readiness.evidence: Software engineering complete for advisory decision support, but 5 of 8 operational and data prerequisites remain BLOCKED or INSUFFICIENT_DATA.

regression_accounting.environment: Python 3.12.14, pytest-9.1.1, pluggy-1.7.0, anyio-4.15.1, OS: Windows

historical_failures_accounted.safety_rationale: High rainfall + High vulnerability without local gauge proximity was downgraded from WATCH to ADVISORY to prevent premature crew dispatch on unconfirmed regional rainfall.
Borderline dark images (mean luminance 15.0) are rejected as inconclusive by strict quality thresholds to avoid false negatives at night.
Borderline whiteout images (mean luminance 240.0) are rejected as inconclusive to avoid false positives caused by specular headlight glare.

historical_failures_accounted.historical_origin: Phase 12 Model vs Observation Contract Partition
historical_failures_accounted.safety_rationale: Critical modeled rainfall without corroborated ground observation yields qualified ADVISORY, strictly forbidding automated WATCH elevation.
